name: scansci-evidence
description: Evidence-first local retrieval and citation contracts for ScanSci Harness.

interface.shortDescription: Find and cite bounded local evidence.
interface.longDescription: A small, host-owned evidence retrieval contract for grounded research answers. It keeps local retrieval, citation anchors, optional JEV reranking, and insufficiency reporting composable.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $evidence-retrieval to answer this question with traceable local evidence.
